models.name: pol_econ_board_posts
models.description: Primary authored posts created by users. Stores ownership and current non-historical attributes (e.g., visibility, language) while detailed content (title/body and attachments) are captured only in immutable snapshots within {@link pol_econ_board_post_versions}. Each post belongs to one Category from {@link pol_econ_board_categories} and is authored by an {@link pol_econ_board_accounts} record. Historical state transitions are tracked in {@link pol_econ_board_post_states}. The model intentionally excludes title/body to preserve normalization; use last-snapshot views or joins for reads.

plainFields.name: visibility
plainFields.description: Business visibility level for the post (e.g., public, limited, staff_only). Serves as current-state filter; historical visibility is captured in versions.

plainFields.name: language
plainFields.description: BCP 47 language tag of the post content (e.g., ko, en-US). Serves as current-state filter; historical language is captured in versions.

plainFields.name: published_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the post was published. Null when draft or unpublished.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when applicable.

models.name: pol_econ_board_post_versions
models.description: Immutable snapshots of post content capturing the state at publication or edit time. Each version references the parent {@link pol_econ_board_posts}, the snapshot Category from {@link pol_econ_board_categories}, and the Author from {@link pol_econ_board_accounts} to preserve historical accuracy. Contains the canonical title and body for that version.

plainFields.name: version_seq
plainFields.description: Monotonic sequence number per post, starting at 1.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title at the time of this version.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Body/content at the time of this version.

plainFields.name: visibility
plainFields.description: Visibility level captured for this version (e.g., public, limited, staff_only).

plainFields.name: language
plainFields.description: Language captured for this version.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot creation timestamp (version creation time).

models.name: pol_econ_board_post_attachments
models.description: Attachments (files, images, documents) associated with a specific {@link pol_econ_board_post_versions} snapshot. This preserves the exact attachment set per version for audit and replay.

plainFields.name: file_uri
plainFields.description: URI pointing to the stored attachment resource.

plainFields.name: file_name
plainFields.description: Original file name at upload time.

plainFields.name: mime_type
plainFields.description: MIME type of the attachment (e.g., image/png, application/pdf).

plainFields.name: file_size
plainFields.description: Attachment size in bytes.

plainFields.name: text_alternative
plainFields.description: Accessibility alt-text/caption. Required by policy for images; optional for non-image files.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when applicable.

models.name: pol_econ_board_comments
models.description: Top-level comments and single-level replies associated with {@link pol_econ_board_posts}. Ownership is tracked via {@link pol_econ_board_accounts}. The comment body itself is stored in {@link pol_econ_board_comment_versions} to preserve edit histories. Parent-child references allow one level of replies via self-reference.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent comment's {@link pol_econ_board_comments.id} for single-level replies.

plainFields.name: visibility
plainFields.description: Business visibility level (e.g., public, limited, staff_only).

plainFields.name: published_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the comment was published. Null prior to publication.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when applicable.

models.name: pol_econ_board_comment_versions
models.description: Immutable snapshots of comment content. Each version references the parent {@link pol_econ_board_comments} and stores the body and optional language at the time of the edit for auditability.

plainFields.name: version_seq
plainFields.description: Monotonic sequence number per comment, starting at 1.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Comment body text at the time of this version.

plainFields.name: language
plainFields.description: Language of this version (optional).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot creation timestamp (version creation time).

models.name: pol_econ_board_mentions
models.description: @Mention records that link a mentioned {@link pol_econ_board_accounts} target to the exact content snapshot where the mention occurred. A mention belongs to either a {@link pol_econ_board_post_versions} or a {@link pol_econ_board_comment_versions} row to preserve historical context. Business rule: exactly one of post_version or comment_version must be non-null (enforced by application logic).

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_post_version_id
foreignFields.description: Source post version's {@link pol_econ_board_post_versions.id} when the mention occurs in a post.

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_comment_version_id
foreignFields.description: Source comment version's {@link pol_econ_board_comment_versions.id} when the mention occurs in a comment.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Mention creation timestamp.

models.name: pol_econ_board_content_sources
models.description: External source references (citations, links) associated with either a {@link pol_econ_board_post_versions} or a {@link pol_econ_board_comment_versions} snapshot. Supports evidence/attribution rules and prevents duplicates per snapshot.

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_post_version_id
foreignFields.description: Associated post version's {@link pol_econ_board_post_versions.id} when the source belongs to a post.

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_comment_version_id
foreignFields.description: Associated comment version's {@link pol_econ_board_comment_versions.id} when the source belongs to a comment.

plainFields.name: source_uri
plainFields.description: URI of the external source (HTTP/HTTPS or other allowed schemes).

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Human-readable title of the source (if available).

plainFields.name: publisher
plainFields.description: Publisher/organization of the source (if available).

plainFields.name: accessed_at
plainFields.description: When the source was last accessed/verified by the author/editor.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

models.name: pol_econ_board_content_warnings
models.description: Content warning labels attached to a specific {@link pol_econ_board_post_versions} snapshot. Optionally links to a centrally defined label in {@link pol_econ_board_label_definitions}. Prevents duplicate warning codes per version.

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_label_definition_id
foreignFields.description: Optional linkage to a label definition {@link pol_econ_board_label_definitions.id} used for this warning.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Business code for the warning (e.g., Sensitive, Satire, Unverified).

plainFields.name: note
plainFields.description: Optional human-readable note providing additional context about the warning.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when applicable.

models.name: pol_econ_board_post_states
models.description: Temporal state history for posts. Records state changes (e.g., draft, published, hidden, archived) with optional reason codes from {@link pol_econ_board_reason_codes} and the actor who applied the change from {@link pol_econ_board_accounts}. Enables auditability and SLA verification.

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_reason_code_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reason code's {@link pol_econ_board_reason_codes.id} explaining the state change.

foreignFields.name: applied_by_account_id
foreignFields.description: Actor account's {@link pol_econ_board_accounts.id} who applied this state change.

plainFields.name: state
plainFields.description: State value (e.g., draft, published, hidden, soft_hidden, archived).

plainFields.name: effective_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this state became effective.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when applicable.

models.name: pol_econ_board_reaction_types
models.description: Master catalog of allowable reaction types for engagement (e.g., "Insightful", "Question"). Used by {@link pol_econ_board_reactions} to ensure reactions are constrained to a known set. Business owners can enable/disable types without touching historical reactions.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Stable business code for the reaction type (e.g., "INSIGHTFUL"). Used for API and configuration references.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable display name of the reaction type.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional administrative description of when and how this reaction type should be used.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Whether this reaction type is currently available for new reactions.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Ordering hint for UI lists; lower numbers appear first.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null means not deleted.

models.name: pol_econ_board_reactions
models.description: High-volume engagement events capturing a user's reaction to either a post or a comment. Each row ties an account and a reaction type to exactly one target (post or comment). Business rule: only one of post or comment is set per row (application-validated). Uniqueness includes deleted_at to allow re-adding after soft deletion while ensuring a single active record.

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link pol_econ_board_posts.id} (nullable when the target is a comment).

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment's {@link pol_econ_board_comments.id} (nullable when the target is a post).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp when the reaction was registered.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (e.g., migration/correction).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp to retract a reaction without losing audit history.

models.name: pol_econ_board_vote_types
models.description: Catalog of allowable vote choices for the platform (e.g., "Agree", "Disagree"). Referenced by {@link pol_econ_board_votes}. Designed to be stable over time and manageable by administrators.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Stable business code for the vote type (e.g., "AGREE", "DISAGREE").

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable display name of the vote type.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional administrative description of the vote type purpose and usage.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Whether this vote type is currently available for new votes.

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Ordering hint for UI lists; lower numbers appear first.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when not deleted.

models.name: pol_econ_board_votes
models.description: User vote signals (e.g., Agree/Disagree) applied to either a post or a comment. Exactly one of post or comment is set per row (application-validated). Uniqueness includes deleted_at to ensure only one active vote exists while allowing historical soft-deleted rows.

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link pol_econ_board_posts.id} (nullable when voting on a comment).

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment's {@link pol_econ_board_comments.id} (nullable when voting on a post).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp when the vote was first recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the vote record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null if not deleted.

models.name: pol_econ_board_expert_recommendations
models.description: Expert-specific endorsement marker distinct from general reactions and votes. Records that a verified expert ({@link pol_econ_board_experts}) recommends a specific post or comment. Used for expert-highlight features and trust signals; uniqueness per expert×target prevents duplicates.

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link pol_econ_board_posts.id} (nullable when the target is a comment).

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment's {@link pol_econ_board_comments.id} (nullable when the target is a post).

plainFields.name: note
plainFields.description: Optional short rationale or curator note for the recommendation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Null means still active.

models.name: pol_econ_board_bookmark_collections
models.description: User-owned bookmark collections providing organization for bookmarks. Each collection belongs to an account ({@link pol_econ_board_accounts}) and can be referenced by many {@link pol_econ_board_bookmarks}. Names are unique per owner to avoid duplicates. Text search over names is supported via GIN. Soft delete is supported for reversible removal.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable collection name. Unique per account for easier selection.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description to explain the collection’s purpose to the owner.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, if the collection is removed but retained for recovery.

models.name: pol_econ_board_bookmarks
models.description: Per-user bookmarks for posts. Each bookmark belongs to an account ({@link pol_econ_board_accounts}) and targets a post ({@link pol_econ_board_posts}). Optionally associated with a {@link pol_econ_board_bookmark_collections} folder. No post data is denormalized; business logic computes display from joins.

plainFields.name: note
plainFields.description: Optional personal note about the bookmark for the owner only.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp when the bookmark was added.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (e.g., note or collection change).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when the bookmark is removed but retained for recovery.

models.name: pol_econ_board_read_states
models.description: Per-user reading telemetry for posts. Tracks first view, progress percentage, and dwell seconds for a post. Belongs to an account ({@link pol_econ_board_accounts}) and a post ({@link pol_econ_board_posts}). Enforces one record per (user, post) to maintain a canonical source of progress.

plainFields.name: first_viewed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user first viewed the post.

plainFields.name: progress_percent
plainFields.description: Latest known reading progress percentage (0–100).

plainFields.name: dwell_seconds
plainFields.description: Cumulative engaged seconds measured by the application for the post.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, if the state is purged logically.

models.name: pol_econ_board_follows
models.description: Unified follows table allowing a user to follow either an author (account), a tag, or a category. Exactly one of the target FKs should be set per row. Prevents duplicates with composite uniques per follow type. Follower is an account ({@link pol_econ_board_accounts}); followed author is {@link pol_econ_board_accounts}; taxonomy targets are {@link pol_econ_board_tags} and {@link pol_econ_board_categories}.

foreignFields.name: followed_pol_econ_board_account_id
foreignFields.description: Followed author account's {@link pol_econ_board_accounts.id} (nullable unless following an author).

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_tag_id
foreignFields.description: Followed tag's {@link pol_econ_board_tags.id} (nullable unless following a tag).

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_category_id
foreignFields.description: Followed category's {@link pol_econ_board_categories.id} (nullable unless following a category).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Follow creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp if the follow is removed logically.

models.name: pol_econ_board_feed_preferences
models.description: Per-account feed preference profile controlling default sort and personalization options. Exactly one row per account ({@link pol_econ_board_accounts}); enforced via unique relation. Stores only raw preference values; ranking logic derives behavior at runtime.

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_account_id
foreignFields.description: Account's {@link pol_econ_board_accounts.id} for which these preferences apply.

plainFields.name: default_sort
plainFields.description: Default feed sort key (e.g., newest, most_reacted, most_agreed).

plainFields.name: diversity_ratio
plainFields.description: Preferred diversity ratio in percent (0–100) used by feed composition logic.

plainFields.name: language
plainFields.description: Preferred content language code for feed filtering (e.g., en, ko).

plainFields.name: prefer_expert_content
plainFields.description: Whether to prioritize expert-authored content in the personalized feed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, if preferences are archived or reset.

models.name: pol_econ_board_saved_items
models.description: Per-user saved items for offline/late reading. Stores a point-in-time text snapshot and metadata of a post ({@link pol_econ_board_posts}) as saved by the account ({@link pol_econ_board_accounts}). No derived metrics are stored. One active snapshot per (user, post).

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link pol_econ_board_posts.id} at time of save.

plainFields.name: snapshot_title
plainFields.description: Title captured at the time of save for the offline snapshot.

plainFields.name: snapshot_body
plainFields.description: Text content captured at the time of save (media references excluded if necessary).

plainFields.name: snapshot_language
plainFields.description: Language code of the snapshot (e.g., en, ko).

plainFields.name: saved_at
plainFields.description: Business timestamp when save action occurred (distinct from created_at if needed).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp when the saved item is removed logically.

models.name: pol_econ_board_muted_sources
models.description: Per-user mutes that reduce or suppress visibility/notifications from specific sources. A mute can target an author account, a post, a tag, or a category. Follower is an account ({@link pol_econ_board_accounts}); targets reference {@link pol_econ_board_accounts}, {@link pol_econ_board_posts}, {@link pol_econ_board_tags}, or {@link pol_econ_board_categories}. Composite uniques per target type prevent duplicates.

foreignFields.name: muted_pol_econ_board_account_id
foreignFields.description: Muted author account's {@link pol_econ_board_accounts.id} (nullable unless muting an account).

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_post_id
foreignFields.description: Muted post's {@link pol_econ_board_posts.id} (nullable unless muting a post).

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_tag_id
foreignFields.description: Muted tag's {@link pol_econ_board_tags.id} (nullable unless muting a tag).

foreignFields.name: pol_econ_board_category_id
foreignFields.description: Muted category's {@link pol_econ_board_categories.id} (nullable unless muting a category).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Optional free-text reason entered by the user for this mute.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Optional timestamp when the mute should automatically expire.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp if the mute is lifted but retained for audit.

models.name: pol_econ_board_user_blocks
models.description: User-to-user blocks that suppress visibility and interactions across the platform at the account level. The blocker and the blocked are both {@link pol_econ_board_accounts}. Composite unique ensures a single block record per pair. Soft deletion enables reversible unblocking with audit history.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Optional free-text reason stored privately for the blocker.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp if the block is lifted.

models.name: pol_econ_board_reports
models.description: Individual user reports against content (post or comment). Stores reporter, target reference, reason code, and optional notes at submission time. Links to reporter tier snapshot for weighting without embedding business logic. FKs to target content use SetNull to preserve evidence on content deletion; taxonomy FKs (reason codes) use NoAction.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Reported post's {@link pol_econ_board_posts.id} (nullable when the target is a comment).

foreignFields.name: comment_id
foreignFields.description: Reported comment's {@link pol_econ_board_comments.id} (nullable when the target is a post).

foreignFields.name: reporter_tier_id
foreignFields.description: Reporter tier snapshot at submission {@link pol_econ_board_reporter_tiers.id}.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Optional free-text notes from the reporter to give context to reviewers.

plainFields.name: weight
plainFields.description: Captured weight at submission time (e.g., credibility weighting). Not calculated by DB; recorded as received.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp (report submitted at).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this report record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, if the report is retracted or purged under policy.

models.name: pol_econ_board_moderation_cases
models.description: Moderation case container aggregating related reports and tracking lifecycle (status, SLA, assignment). Actions and sanctions are recorded in {@link pol_econ_board_moderation_actions} and {@link pol_econ_board_sanctions}. Assignment now references {@link pol_econ_board_moderators} to enforce RBAC. plainFields.description: Current case status (e.g., triage, under_review, action_applied, closed).

plainFields.name: priority

plainFields.name: summary
plainFields.description: Optional case summary for human-readable context.

plainFields.name: opened_at

plainFields.name: closed_at
plainFields.description: Case closure timestamp if resolved.

plainFields.name: sla_due_at
plainFields.description: SLA due timestamp for first response or resolution per policy.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for the case record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the case record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp if the case is obsoleted per policy.

models.name: pol_econ_board_moderation_actions
models.description: Atomic actions/decisions taken during a moderation case with provenance and optional reason code. Serves as the auditable action log for {@link pol_econ_board_moderation_cases}.

foreignFields.description: Optional reason code for classification {@link pol_econ_board_reason_codes.id}.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Action type label (e.g., label, hide, remove, warn).

plainFields.name: rationale
plainFields.description: Optional human rationale or notes supporting the action.

plainFields.name: effective_from
plainFields.description: When the action takes effect (if deferred).

plainFields.name: effective_to
plainFields.description: When the action effect ends, if applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for this action record.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for this action record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for this action record.

models.name: pol_econ_board_sanctions

plainFields.name: sanction_type
plainFields.description: Sanction type (e.g., warning, feature_restriction, suspend_24h, suspend_7d, suspend_30d, permanent).

plainFields.name: reason_summary
plainFields.description: Optional summary for transparency and internal review.

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: pol_econ_board_transparency_logs
models.description: Public transparency records summarizing moderation outcomes for cases, including publication timestamp and optional public URL. Supports periodic transparency reporting requirements.

plainFields.name: public_summary
plainFields.description: Public-facing summary of the action/decision suitable for transparency reporting.

plainFields.name: published_at
plainFields.description: Publication timestamp.

plainFields.name: visibility
plainFields.description: Visibility scope (e.g., public, staff_only).

plainFields.name: url
plainFields.description: Optional URL to a published transparency page or report entry.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for the transparency log.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the transparency log.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for the transparency log.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the appeal record.

models.name: pol_econ_board_appeal_decisions
models.description: 1:1 decision outcome for a given appeal including outcome and rationale. Links back to {@link pol_econ_board_appeals}.

plainFields.name: outcome
plainFields.description: Decision outcome (e.g., upheld, modified, reversed).

plainFields.description: Optional rationale for the decision.

### `pol_econ_board_app_settings`

Application-level configuration entries scoped by environment. Stores
atomic key-value pairs that influence platform behavior (e.g.,
thresholds, toggles) without denormalized or computed data. Authorship
and maintenance are performed by [pol_econ_board_admins](#pol_econ_board_admins). Each
(environment, key) combination is unique. Search on description supports
operator-facing discovery.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `created_by_admin_id`: Authoring administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins)
- `updated_by_admin_id`: Last updating administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins)
- `environment`
  > Logical environment for the setting. Examples: "production", "staging",
  > "development". Used to scope configuration safely by deployment context.
- `key`
  > Business identifier for the configuration setting. Must be unique within
  > the same environment.
- `value`
  > Raw setting value in string form. Interpretation is application-defined;
  > no computed or derived values are stored here.
- `category`
  > Optional grouping for operators (e.g., "auth", "governance",
  > "notifications").
- `description`: Human-readable explanation of the setting's purpose and acceptable values.
- `active`: Whether this setting is currently active in the specified environment.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when setting is retired.

### `pol_econ_board_feature_flags`

Feature flag definitions controlling conditional behavior by environment
with optional rollout strategies. Supports time-bounded activation and
percentage rollouts. Managed by administrators in {@link
pol_econ_board_admins}. Uniqueness enforced per (environment, name).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `created_by_admin_id`: Authoring administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins)
- `updated_by_admin_id`: Last updating administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins)
- `environment`
  > Environment scope for the flag. Examples: "production", "staging",
  > "development".
- `name`: Feature flag name unique within the same environment.
- `description`: Operator-facing description of what this flag controls.
- `enabled`
  > Whether the flag is currently enabled (subject to time windows and
  > strategy).
- `rollout_strategy`
  > Strategy keyword indicating how the flag is rolled out. Examples: "all",
  > "percentage", "role_based".
- `rollout_percentage`: Optional percentage (0–100) when rollout_strategy is "percentage".
- `starts_at`: Optional activation start time. When null, active immediately if enabled.
- `ends_at`: Optional activation end time. When null, no scheduled end.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when retired.

### `pol_econ_board_maintenance_windows`

Planned or active maintenance windows defining service impact scope and
tier. Prevents duplication via unique codes and unique (scope, starts_at,
ends_at). Authored/approved by [pol_econ_board_admins](#pol_econ_board_admins). Optimized
for time-range queries and operator search.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `created_by_admin_id`: Authoring administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins)
- `approved_by_admin_id`
  > Approving administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins) when required
  > by policy.
- `code`: Unique business identifier for the maintenance window.
- `title`: Human-readable title of the maintenance window.
- `description`: Detailed description of scope, steps, and risk notes.
- `scope`: Business scope affected (e.g., "all", "auth", "feeds").
- `impact_tier`: Impact tier label (e.g., "P0", "P1", "P2").
- `status`
  > Lifecycle state such as "planned", "in_progress", "completed", or
  > "canceled".
- `starts_at`: Start timestamp of the maintenance window.
- `ends_at`: End timestamp of the maintenance window.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when retired.

### `pol_econ_board_election_policies`

Versioned election-period policy records defining stricter moderation and
publishing rules during sensitive periods. Includes effective window,
active flag, and approval metadata. Authored/approved by {@link
pol_econ_board_admins}.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `created_by_admin_id`: Authoring administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins)
- `updated_by_admin_id`: Updating administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins)
- `approved_by_admin_id`: Approving administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins)
- `code`
  > Business identifier for the election policy family (e.g.,
  > "kr-assembly-2026"). Combined with version for uniqueness.
- `version`: Monotonic version number within the same code family.
- `title`: Human-readable title for the policy record.
- `description`: Detailed description of rules and scope.
- `effective_from`: Policy activation start timestamp.
- `effective_to`: Policy deactivation timestamp.
- `active`: Whether this version is currently active within its effective window.
- `review_notes`: Optional reviewer notes for internal reference.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when retired.

### `pol_econ_board_reason_codes`

Canonical, normalized catalog of moderation reason codes used across
governance workflows. Each code is unique and categorized with a severity
level. Managed by [pol_econ_board_admins](#pol_econ_board_admins).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `created_by_admin_id`: Authoring administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins)
- `updated_by_admin_id`: Last updating administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins)
- `code`
  > Unique machine-readable code (e.g., "ILLEGAL_THREAT", "HATE_SPEECH",
  > "SPAM").
- `name`: Human-readable name of the reason.
- `category`
  > Reason family (e.g., "Safety", "Integrity", "Quality", "Election
  > Integrity").
- `severity`: Business severity level (e.g., "low", "medium", "high").
- `description`: Detailed description and guidance for usage.
- `active`: Whether the reason code is currently usable.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when retired.

### `pol_econ_board_label_definitions`

Catalog of policy labels (e.g., "Unverified", "Sourced", "Satire", "Paid
Promotion"). Indicates whether a disclaimer is required and stores
optional disclaimer text. Managed by [pol_econ_board_admins](#pol_econ_board_admins).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `created_by_admin_id`: Authoring administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins)
- `updated_by_admin_id`: Last updating administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins)
- `key`: Unique key for the label (e.g., "unverified", "sourced", "satire").
- `name`: Display name of the label.
- `category`: Label grouping (e.g., "Integrity", "Disclosure").
- `description`: Operator-facing description of when to apply the label.
- `requires_disclaimer`: Whether the label requires a disclaimer to be shown to users.
- `disclaimer_text`: Optional disclaimer copy to render when required.
- `active`: Whether this label is currently available for use.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when retired.

### `pol_econ_board_prohibited_categories`

Policy catalog of prohibited or restricted categories (e.g.,
ad/sponsorship restrictions). Scopes may reflect business areas like ads,
sponsorships, or notifications. Managed by [pol_econ_board_admins](#pol_econ_board_admins).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `created_by_admin_id`: Authoring administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins)
- `updated_by_admin_id`: Last updating administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins)
- `code`
  > Unique category code (e.g., "POLITICAL_CAMPAIGN_ADS",
  > "SENSITIVE_CATEGORIES").
- `name`: Human-readable category name.
- `scope`
  > Business scope where this category applies (e.g., "ads", "sponsorships",
  > "notifications").
- `description`: Explanation and examples of the category.
- `active`: Whether this category restriction is currently active.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when retired.

### `pol_econ_board_content_policies`

Versioned content policy records that define general content rules and
disclosures beyond election-period specifics. Includes time-bounded
effectiveness, activation state, and review cycle metadata. Managed by
[pol_econ_board_admins](#pol_econ_board_admins).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `created_by_admin_id`: Authoring administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins)
- `updated_by_admin_id`: Last updating administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins)
- `approved_by_admin_id`
  > Approving administrator's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins) when approvals
  > are required by policy.
- `code`
  > Business identifier for the policy family (e.g., "general-governance").
  > Combined with version for uniqueness.
- `version`: Monotonic version number within the same code family.
- `title`: Policy title for operator discovery and references.
- `body`: Full text of the content policy. Stored as raw text (no derived fields).
- `category`: Optional grouping (e.g., "governance", "safety").
- `active`: Whether this policy version is currently active.
- `effective_from`: Optional start timestamp of the policy effectiveness.
- `effective_to`: Optional end timestamp of the policy effectiveness.
- `review_cycle_days`: Optional number of days between scheduled reviews for this policy.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when retired.

### `pol_econ_board_accounts`

Root identity entity for all users (members, experts, moderators,
editors, admins). Holds contact identifiers and canonical account state.
Roles are linked via 1:1 tables such as [pol_econ_board_members](#pol_econ_board_members).
Used by authentication, authorization, and audit subsystems. Business
uniqueness is enforced on email and handle for discovery and
mentionability. Soft deletion supports data lifecycle and legal holds.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`
  > Primary contact email address for the account. Unique per business rules
  > and used for login and communications.
- `display_name`: User-visible display name presented in profiles and content surfaces.
- `handle`: Unique handle (username) used for mentions and profile routing.
- `state`
  > Canonical account state: pending_verification, active,
  > suspended_temporary, suspended_permanent, disabled_security,
  > deleted_pending, deleted_final.
- `email_verified`
  > Whether the email address has been verified by a completed verification
  > flow.
- `last_login_at`
  > Timestamp of the most recent successful login for this account, used for
  > security review and UX cues.
- `locale`: Preferred locale code for communications (e.g., en-US, ko-KR).
- `timezone`
  > Preferred timezone identifier for scheduling and notification windows
  > (e.g., Asia/Seoul).
- `suspended_until`
  > If temporarily suspended, the end timestamp when the account should be
  > restored automatically.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the account record.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the account record.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp. When set, the account is logically deleted
  > subject to retention and holds.

### `pol_econ_board_members`

Member role profile representing a registered participant in the
community. 1:1 with [pol_econ_board_accounts](#pol_econ_board_accounts). Contains role-scoped
metadata, independent from credentials and identity for clean RBAC
boundaries.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Belonged account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `joined_at`: When the member role became active for this account.
- `profile_bio`: Optional short bio shown on the member profile.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the member role record.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the member role record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for the member role.

### `pol_econ_board_experts`

Expert role profile for verified domain specialists. 1:1 with {@link
pol_econ_board_accounts}. Stores verification state and optional
disclosure metadata required by governance policies.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Belonged account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `verified`
  > Whether this expert has completed verification and is currently in good
  > standing.
- `verified_at`: Timestamp of verification approval; null if not verified.
- `badge_label`: Optional public-facing badge label for the expert (e.g., "Economist").
- `affiliation`: Optional affiliation or employer used for disclosure when relevant.
- `biography`: Optional extended biography text for profile surfaces.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the expert role record.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the expert role record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for the expert role.

### `pol_econ_board_moderators`

Moderator role profile for governance operators. 1:1 with {@link
pol_econ_board_accounts}. Captures assignment start and optional scope
metadata for operational boundaries.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Belonged account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `assigned_since`: Date/time when moderator privileges became effective for this account.
- `scope`
  > Optional text describing moderation scope or specialization (e.g.,
  > category focus).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the moderator role record.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the moderator role record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for the moderator role.

### `pol_econ_board_editors`

Editor role profile for curation operators. 1:1 with {@link
pol_econ_board_accounts}. Tracks assignment and optional specialization
details.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Belonged account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `assigned_since`: Date/time when editor privileges became effective for this account.
- `specialization`: Optional editorial specialization or beat.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the editor role record.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the editor role record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for the editor role.

### `pol_econ_board_admins`

Admin role profile for organization-level operators. 1:1 with {@link
pol_econ_board_accounts}. Captures assignment and capability flags such
as superuser mode for emergency response.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Belonged account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `assigned_since`: Date/time when admin privileges became effective for this account.
- `superuser`: Whether the admin account has superuser capabilities enabled.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the admin role record.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the admin role record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for the admin role.

### `pol_econ_board_credentials`

Authentication credential record linked 1:1 with {@link
pol_econ_board_accounts}. Stores password material and reset workflow
data separate from identity for least privilege and rotation. No login
counters are exposed beyond what is necessary for security operations.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Owner account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `password_hash`: Password hash material as a string per chosen hashing scheme.
- `password_salt`: Optional salt material if hashing scheme requires it.
- `password_updated_at`: Timestamp when the password was last changed.
- `password_reset_token`: Optional single-use token for password reset flows.
- `password_reset_expires_at`: Expiration timestamp for the current password reset token if present.
- `mfa_enforced`
  > Whether multi-factor authentication is currently enforced for this
  > account.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the credentials record.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the credentials record.

### `pol_econ_board_email_verifications`

Email verification tokens for [pol_econ_board_accounts](#pol_econ_board_accounts). Supports
30-minute TTL and one-time consumption for email ownership proof.
Multiple tokens can exist over time per account.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Target account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `token`: Single-use verification token value. Unique across active tokens.
- `sent_to_email`
  > The email address the verification was sent to (for audit and multi-email
  > flows).
- `expires_at`: Token expiration timestamp (business default 30 minutes).
- `consumed_at`: Timestamp when the token was used; null if unused.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the verification token record.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the verification token record.

### `pol_econ_board_sessions`

Logical authentication sessions for [pol_econ_board_accounts](#pol_econ_board_accounts).
Tracks lifecycle including creation, last activity, expiry, and
revocation. Device information included for security review and user
device management.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Owner account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `user_agent`: User agent string observed when the session was created.
- `ip`: IP address observed at session creation.
- `device_label`: Optional user-facing device label for this session.
- `trusted_device`
  > Whether this session is on a trusted device (reduced MFA prompts per
  > policy).
- `last_activity_at`: Last observed activity timestamp for the session.
- `expires_at`: Absolute expiration timestamp for the session.
- `revoked_at`: Revocation timestamp if the session was explicitly terminated.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the session record.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the session record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for the session record.

### `pol_econ_board_refresh_tokens`

Refresh tokens tied to [pol_econ_board_sessions](#pol_econ_board_sessions) and {@link
pol_econ_board_accounts}. Supports rotation families, revocation, and
reuse detection per security policy.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_session_id`: Related session's [pol_econ_board_sessions.id](#pol_econ_board_sessions)
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Owner account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `token`: Opaque refresh token string. Unique across the system.
- `family_id`
  > Identifier for the rotation family used to detect reuse and revoke
  > families.
- `issued_at`: Timestamp when the token was issued.
- `expires_at`: Expiration timestamp for the token.
- `rotated_from_token`: Optional reference to the prior token value that this token replaced.
- `revoked_at`: Revocation timestamp if the token is no longer valid.
- `revocation_reason`: Optional human-readable revocation rationale (e.g., reuse detected).
- `ip`: IP address observed at token issuance or last use.
- `user_agent`: User agent observed at token issuance or last use.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the refresh token record.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the refresh token record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for the refresh token record.

### `pol_econ_board_mfa_methods`

Multi-factor authentication (MFA) methods registered for {@link
pol_econ_board_accounts}. Records factor type (e.g., TOTP, SMS),
enablement/verification state, and usage timestamps. Composite uniqueness
per account+method prevents duplicates.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Owner account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `method`: MFA method type label such as "TOTP" or "SMS" per policy.
- `label`: Optional user label for the MFA method (e.g., "Phone", "Authenticator").
- `secret`: Secret material required by the method (e.g., TOTP seed) where applicable.
- `enabled`: Whether this factor is enabled for sign-in or step-up.
- `verified`: Whether this factor has been verified/confirmed.
- `last_used_at`: Timestamp this method was last used successfully.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the MFA method record.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the MFA method record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for the MFA method record.

### `pol_econ_board_device_sessions`

Trusted device registry for [pol_econ_board_accounts](#pol_econ_board_accounts). Supports
"remember this device" flows and reduced MFA prompts within trust
windows. Fingerprint is application-defined and unique per account.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Owner account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `device_fingerprint`
  > Opaque device fingerprint string uniquely identifying a device for this
  > account.
- `device_label`: Optional user-facing label for the trusted device.
- `trusted_until`: Date/time until which the device is trusted for reduced MFA prompts.
- `last_ip`: Most recent IP address observed for this device.
- `last_seen_at`: Most recent activity timestamp observed for this device.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the device trust record.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp of the device trust record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for the device trust record.

### `pol_econ_board_audit_logs`

Immutable audit trail for security and governance events (e.g., login,
logout, role changes, token rotations). References actor {@link
pol_econ_board_accounts} (nullable for system actions) and stores generic
target typing via resource_type and resource_id to avoid cross-component
FK coupling. Enables compliance reporting and incident reviews.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`
  > Actor account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts); null for
  > system-initiated events.
- `category`
  > Business category of the event (e.g., AUTH, SESSION, PERMISSION, ROLE,
  > SECURITY, COMPLIANCE).
- `action`
  > Action descriptor (e.g., "login_success", "password_reset_requested",
  > "role_assigned").
- `resource_type`
  > Generic resource type label for the target (e.g., "account", "post",
  > "moderation_case").
- `resource_id`
  > Target resource identifier when applicable; stored without FK to allow
  > polymorphism across components.
- `success`: Whether the operation completed successfully.
- `reason_code`: Optional standardized reason code associated with the action.
- `correlation_id`
  > Optional correlation/support identifier to link user-facing errors and
  > backend logs.
- `ip`: IP address associated with the event, if available.
- `user_agent`: User agent string associated with the event, if available.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp of the audit event record.
- `updated_at`
  > Last update timestamp of the audit event record (normally equal to
  > created_at).
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for redaction workflows where permitted by policy.

### `pol_econ_board_categories`

Editorial taxonomy categories for organizing posts. Supports hierarchical
structures via optional self-referencing parent. Typically curated by
editors. Uniqueness is enforced through slugs and optionally names to
prevent duplicates across taxonomy. Related entities: {@link
pol_econ_board_posts} through categorization features and {@link
pol_econ_board_tags} where taxonomy intersects with tagging. Parent
onDelete is SetNull to avoid accidental subtree deletions.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `parent_id`
  > Parent category's [pol_econ_board_categories.id](#pol_econ_board_categories). Enables
  > hierarchical taxonomy. SetNull on delete to preserve children.
- `pol_econ_board_editor_id`
  > Owning editor's [pol_econ_board_editors.id](#pol_econ_board_editors). Indicates editorial
  > ownership/creator.
- `name`: Human-readable category name used in UI and listings.
- `slug`
  > URL-friendly unique identifier for the category used in routing and
  > lookups.
- `description`: Optional descriptive text providing context for the category.
- `active`: Whether the category is active for new assignments and visibility.
- `order_index`
  > Optional display ordering index for curated lists. Purely a presentation
  > hint.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when the category is active.

### `pol_econ_board_tags`

Editorial tags used to label posts for discovery and personalization.
Managed by editors, independent from hierarchical categories. Uniqueness
enforced via slug and name. Related through {@link
pol_econ_board_post_tags} to [pol_econ_board_posts](#pol_econ_board_posts).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_editor_id`
  > Owning editor's [pol_econ_board_editors.id](#pol_econ_board_editors). Indicates who
  > created/manages this tag.
- `name`: Human-readable tag name. Used in search and UI.
- `slug`: URL-friendly unique identifier for the tag used in routing and lookups.
- `description`: Optional explanatory description for editorial context.
- `active`: Whether the tag is available for assignment and discovery.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when active.

### `pol_econ_board_post_tags`

Junction table connecting posts and tags to implement M:N relationships.
Each row records a tag assignment to a post with audit timestamps.
Prevents duplicate assignments via composite unique constraint. Related
entities: [pol_econ_board_posts](#pol_econ_board_posts), [pol_econ_board_tags](#pol_econ_board_tags).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_post_id`: Target post's [pol_econ_board_posts.id](#pol_econ_board_posts).
- `pol_econ_board_tag_id`: Assigned tag's [pol_econ_board_tags.id](#pol_econ_board_tags).
- `created_at`: Assignment creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for this assignment record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if the assignment is removed.

pol_econ_board_collection_items}.

Properties as follows:

- `name`: Collection name displayed to users.
- `slug`: Unique slug for the collection used in URLs and lookups.
- `description`: Optional descriptive text for the collection.
- `visibility`
  > Visibility label for the collection (e.g., public, private, staff-only)
  > used for business rules.
- `active`: Whether the collection is actively featured/used.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp.

### `pol_econ_board_collection_items`

Items assigned to a curated collection, referencing posts. Maintains
order within a collection and avoids duplicates per (collection, post).
Related to [pol_econ_board_curated_collections](#pol_econ_board_curated_collections) and {@link
pol_econ_board_posts}.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_curated_collection_id`: Owning collection's [pol_econ_board_curated_collections.id](#pol_econ_board_curated_collections).
- `pol_econ_board_post_id`: Referenced post's [pol_econ_board_posts.id](#pol_econ_board_posts).
- `pol_econ_board_editor_id`: Editor who added the item [pol_econ_board_editors.id](#pol_econ_board_editors).
- `position`: Ordering position within the collection for deterministic display.
- `note`: Optional editor note about why this post is included.
- `created_at`: Assignment creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for this collection item.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp.

### `pol_econ_board_pinned_posts`

Editorial pin records for elevating posts in specific scopes (e.g., home,
section/category). Tracks who pinned, optional category scoping,
expiration, and reasons. Enforces uniqueness per (post, scope) to avoid
duplicate pins in the same context. Related to {@link
pol_econ_board_posts}, [pol_econ_board_categories](#pol_econ_board_categories), and {@link
pol_econ_board_editors}. Adds a composite index for common retrieval by
scope/category with priority.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_post_id`: Pinned post's [pol_econ_board_posts.id](#pol_econ_board_posts).
- `pol_econ_board_editor_id`: Editor who performed the pin action [pol_econ_board_editors.id](#pol_econ_board_editors).
- `pol_econ_board_category_id`
  > Optional category scope [pol_econ_board_categories.id](#pol_econ_board_categories) if the pin
  > is section/category-specific.
- `scope`: Editorial scope for the pin (e.g., home, section, topic identifier).
- `reason`: Optional reason or note explaining the pin decision.
- `expires_at`
  > Optional expiration for the pin after which it should no longer be
  > displayed.
- `priority`: Optional priority value used to sort multiple pins within the same scope.
- `created_at`: Pin creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for this pin record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp.

### `pol_econ_board_announcements`

Editorial announcements and service notices authored by editors/admins
with controlled visibility and publish windows. Provides searchable
titles via GIN index and clear time-bounded presentation through
start/end timestamps. Related to [pol_econ_board_editors](#pol_econ_board_editors). Adds an
index for visibility + start time to speed common filters.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_editor_id`: Authoring editor's [pol_econ_board_editors.id](#pol_econ_board_editors).
- `title`: Announcement title displayed in lists and headers.
- `body`: Announcement content body (plain or formatted text, stored as raw text).
- `language`: BCP47 or service-defined language tag for localization purposes.
- `visibility`
  > Visibility scope (e.g., public, staff-only) controlling who can view the
  > announcement.
- `published_start_at`: Timestamp when the announcement becomes visible.
- `published_end_at`: Optional timestamp when the announcement should stop being visible.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp.

### `pol_econ_board_scheduled_publications`

Scheduling records for post publications managed by editors. Captures the
scheduled time, status, and actual execution/cancellation timestamps for
auditability. Prevents duplicate scheduling of the same post at the same
time via composite unique constraint. Related to {@link
pol_econ_board_posts} and [pol_econ_board_editors](#pol_econ_board_editors).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_post_id`: Target post's [pol_econ_board_posts.id](#pol_econ_board_posts) to be scheduled.
- `pol_econ_board_editor_id`: Scheduling editor's [pol_econ_board_editors.id](#pol_econ_board_editors).
- `scheduled_for`: Planned publication time for the post.
- `status`: Operational status of the schedule (e.g., pending, executed, canceled).
- `executed_at`: Actual execution time when the post was published, if applicable.
- `canceled_at`: Timestamp when the schedule was canceled, if applicable.
- `note`: Optional scheduler note or rationale for future reference.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp for this schedule.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp.

### `pol_econ_board_taxonomy_changes`

Snapshot/audit log for taxonomy modifications (categories or tags).
Records the actor account, target entity, change type, field changed, and
before/after values. Supports governance, transparency, and rollback
investigations without denormalizing primary entities. Targets: {@link
pol_econ_board_categories}, [pol_econ_board_tags](#pol_econ_board_tags), actor {@link
pol_econ_board_accounts}. To preserve audit history, actor and target
foreign keys use onDelete: SetNull.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`
  > Actor account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts) who performed the
  > change. Nullable to preserve logs when the account is removed.
- `pol_econ_board_category_id`
  > Target category's [pol_econ_board_categories.id](#pol_econ_board_categories), if the change is
  > about a category. Nullable to preserve logs after category deletion.
- `pol_econ_board_tag_id`
  > Target tag's [pol_econ_board_tags.id](#pol_econ_board_tags), if the change is about a
  > tag. Nullable to preserve logs after tag deletion.
- `target_type`: Target entity type for the change (e.g., category, tag).
- `change_type`: Type of change performed (e.g., create, update, delete).
- `field_name`: Name of the field affected by the change (e.g., name, slug, description).
- `old_value`
  > Previous value for the field before the change. Null when not applicable
  > (e.g., on create).
- `new_value`
  > New value for the field after the change. Null when not applicable (e.g.,
  > on delete).
- `reason`: Optional rationale or context provided by the actor for this change.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the change was recorded.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of the last update to this change record (e.g., correction).
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp (typically unused for immutable logs).

### `pol_econ_board_posts`

Primary authored posts created by users. Stores ownership and current
non-historical attributes (e.g., visibility, language) while detailed
content (title/body and attachments) are captured only in immutable
snapshots within [pol_econ_board_post_versions](#pol_econ_board_post_versions). Each post belongs
to one Category from [pol_econ_board_categories](#pol_econ_board_categories) and is authored by
an [pol_econ_board_accounts](#pol_econ_board_accounts) record. Historical state transitions
are tracked in [pol_econ_board_post_states](#pol_econ_board_post_states). The model
intentionally excludes title/body to preserve normalization; use
last-snapshot views or joins for reads.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Author's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `pol_econ_board_category_id`: Category's [pol_econ_board_categories.id](#pol_econ_board_categories)
- `visibility`
  > Business visibility level for the post (e.g., public, limited,
  > staff_only). Serves as current-state filter; historical visibility is
  > captured in versions.
- `language`
  > BCP 47 language tag of the post content (e.g., ko, en-US). Serves as
  > current-state filter; historical language is captured in versions.
- `published_at`: Timestamp when the post was published. Null when draft or unpublished.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when applicable.

### `pol_econ_board_post_versions`

Immutable snapshots of post content capturing the state at publication or
edit time. Each version references the parent {@link
pol_econ_board_posts}, the snapshot Category from {@link
pol_econ_board_categories}, and the Author from {@link
pol_econ_board_accounts} to preserve historical accuracy. Contains the
canonical title and body for that version.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_post_id`: Parent post's [pol_econ_board_posts.id](#pol_econ_board_posts)
- `pol_econ_board_category_id`: Snapshot Category's [pol_econ_board_categories.id](#pol_econ_board_categories)
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Snapshot author's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `version_seq`: Monotonic sequence number per post, starting at 1.
- `title`: Title at the time of this version.
- `body`: Body/content at the time of this version.
- `visibility`
  > Visibility level captured for this version (e.g., public, limited,
  > staff_only).
- `language`: Language captured for this version.
- `created_at`: Snapshot creation timestamp (version creation time).

### `pol_econ_board_post_attachments`

Attachments (files, images, documents) associated with a specific {@link
pol_econ_board_post_versions} snapshot. This preserves the exact
attachment set per version for audit and replay.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_post_version_id`: Snapshot's [pol_econ_board_post_versions.id](#pol_econ_board_post_versions)
- `file_uri`: URI pointing to the stored attachment resource.
- `file_name`: Original file name at upload time.
- `mime_type`: MIME type of the attachment (e.g., image/png, application/pdf).
- `file_size`: Attachment size in bytes.
- `text_alternative`
  > Accessibility alt-text/caption. Required by policy for images; optional
  > for non-image files.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when applicable.

### `pol_econ_board_comments`

Top-level comments and single-level replies associated with {@link
pol_econ_board_posts}. Ownership is tracked via {@link
pol_econ_board_accounts}. The comment body itself is stored in {@link
pol_econ_board_comment_versions} to preserve edit histories. Parent-child
references allow one level of replies via self-reference.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_post_id`: Target post's [pol_econ_board_posts.id](#pol_econ_board_posts)
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Author's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `parent_id`
  > Parent comment's [pol_econ_board_comments.id](#pol_econ_board_comments) for single-level
  > replies.
- `visibility`: Business visibility level (e.g., public, limited, staff_only).
- `published_at`: Timestamp when the comment was published. Null prior to publication.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when applicable.

### `pol_econ_board_comment_versions`

Immutable snapshots of comment content. Each version references the
parent [pol_econ_board_comments](#pol_econ_board_comments) and stores the body and optional
language at the time of the edit for auditability.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_comment_id`: Parent comment's [pol_econ_board_comments.id](#pol_econ_board_comments)
- `version_seq`: Monotonic sequence number per comment, starting at 1.
- `body`: Comment body text at the time of this version.
- `language`: Language of this version (optional).
- `created_at`: Snapshot creation timestamp (version creation time).

### `pol_econ_board_mentions`

target to the exact content snapshot where the mention occurred. A
mention belongs to either a [pol_econ_board_post_versions](#pol_econ_board_post_versions) or a
[pol_econ_board_comment_versions](#pol_econ_board_comment_versions) row to preserve historical
context. Business rule: exactly one of post_version or comment_version
must be non-null (enforced by application logic).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Mentioned user's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `pol_econ_board_post_version_id`
  > Source post version's [pol_econ_board_post_versions.id](#pol_econ_board_post_versions) when the
  > mention occurs in a post.
- `pol_econ_board_comment_version_id`
  > Source comment version's [pol_econ_board_comment_versions.id](#pol_econ_board_comment_versions) when
  > the mention occurs in a comment.
- `created_at`: Mention creation timestamp.

### `pol_econ_board_content_sources`

External source references (citations, links) associated with either a
[pol_econ_board_post_versions](#pol_econ_board_post_versions) or a {@link
pol_econ_board_comment_versions} snapshot. Supports evidence/attribution
rules and prevents duplicates per snapshot.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_post_version_id`
  > Associated post version's [pol_econ_board_post_versions.id](#pol_econ_board_post_versions) when
  > the source belongs to a post.
- `pol_econ_board_comment_version_id`
  > Associated comment version's [pol_econ_board_comment_versions.id](#pol_econ_board_comment_versions)
  > when the source belongs to a comment.
- `source_uri`: URI of the external source (HTTP/HTTPS or other allowed schemes).
- `title`: Human-readable title of the source (if available).
- `publisher`: Publisher/organization of the source (if available).
- `accessed_at`: When the source was last accessed/verified by the author/editor.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.

### `pol_econ_board_content_warnings`

Content warning labels attached to a specific {@link
pol_econ_board_post_versions} snapshot. Optionally links to a centrally
defined label in [pol_econ_board_label_definitions](#pol_econ_board_label_definitions). Prevents
duplicate warning codes per version.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_post_version_id`: Target post version's [pol_econ_board_post_versions.id](#pol_econ_board_post_versions)
- `pol_econ_board_label_definition_id`
  > Optional linkage to a label definition {@link
  > pol_econ_board_label_definitions.id} used for this warning.
- `code`: Business code for the warning (e.g., Sensitive, Satire, Unverified).
- `note`
  > Optional human-readable note providing additional context about the
  > warning.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when applicable.

### `pol_econ_board_post_states`

Temporal state history for posts. Records state changes (e.g., draft,
published, hidden, archived) with optional reason codes from {@link
pol_econ_board_reason_codes} and the actor who applied the change from
[pol_econ_board_accounts](#pol_econ_board_accounts). Enables auditability and SLA
verification.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_post_id`: Target post's [pol_econ_board_posts.id](#pol_econ_board_posts)
- `pol_econ_board_reason_code_id`
  > Optional reason code's [pol_econ_board_reason_codes.id](#pol_econ_board_reason_codes) explaining
  > the state change.
- `applied_by_account_id`
  > Actor account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts) who applied this state
  > change.
- `state`: State value (e.g., draft, published, hidden, soft_hidden, archived).
- `effective_at`: Timestamp when this state became effective.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when applicable.

### `pol_econ_board_reaction_types`

Master catalog of allowable reaction types for engagement (e.g.,
"Insightful", "Question"). Used by [pol_econ_board_reactions](#pol_econ_board_reactions) to
ensure reactions are constrained to a known set. Business owners can
enable/disable types without touching historical reactions.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `code`
  > Stable business code for the reaction type (e.g., "INSIGHTFUL"). Used for
  > API and configuration references.
- `name`: Human-readable display name of the reaction type.
- `description`
  > Optional administrative description of when and how this reaction type
  > should be used.
- `active`: Whether this reaction type is currently available for new reactions.
- `display_order`: Ordering hint for UI lists; lower numbers appear first.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp. Null means not deleted.

### `pol_econ_board_reactions`

High-volume engagement events capturing a user's reaction to either a
post or a comment. Each row ties an account and a reaction type to
exactly one target (post or comment). Business rule: only one of post or
comment is set per row (application-validated). Uniqueness includes
deleted_at to allow re-adding after soft deletion while ensuring a single
active record.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Reacting account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `pol_econ_board_post_id`
  > Target post's [pol_econ_board_posts.id](#pol_econ_board_posts) (nullable when the target
  > is a comment).
- `pol_econ_board_comment_id`
  > Target comment's [pol_econ_board_comments.id](#pol_econ_board_comments) (nullable when the
  > target is a post).
- `pol_econ_board_reaction_type_id`: Reaction type's [pol_econ_board_reaction_types.id](#pol_econ_board_reaction_types)
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp when the reaction was registered.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp (e.g., migration/correction).
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp to retract a reaction without losing audit
  > history.

### `pol_econ_board_vote_types`

Catalog of allowable vote choices for the platform (e.g., "Agree",
"Disagree"). Referenced by [pol_econ_board_votes](#pol_econ_board_votes). Designed to be
stable over time and manageable by administrators.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `code`: Stable business code for the vote type (e.g., "AGREE", "DISAGREE").
- `name`: Human-readable display name of the vote type.
- `description`: Optional administrative description of the vote type purpose and usage.
- `active`: Whether this vote type is currently available for new votes.
- `display_order`: Ordering hint for UI lists; lower numbers appear first.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp. Null when not deleted.

### `pol_econ_board_votes`

User vote signals (e.g., Agree/Disagree) applied to either a post or a
comment. Exactly one of post or comment is set per row
(application-validated). Uniqueness includes deleted_at to ensure only
one active vote exists while allowing historical soft-deleted rows.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Voting account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `pol_econ_board_post_id`
  > Target post's [pol_econ_board_posts.id](#pol_econ_board_posts) (nullable when voting on a
  > comment).
- `pol_econ_board_comment_id`
  > Target comment's [pol_econ_board_comments.id](#pol_econ_board_comments) (nullable when voting
  > on a post).
- `pol_econ_board_vote_type_id`: Vote type's [pol_econ_board_vote_types.id](#pol_econ_board_vote_types).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp when the vote was first recorded.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for the vote record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp. Null if not deleted.

### `pol_econ_board_expert_recommendations`

Expert-specific endorsement marker distinct from general reactions and
votes. Records that a verified expert ([pol_econ_board_experts](#pol_econ_board_experts))
recommends a specific post or comment. Used for expert-highlight features
and trust signals; uniqueness per expert×target prevents duplicates.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_expert_id`: Recommending expert's [pol_econ_board_experts.id](#pol_econ_board_experts).
- `pol_econ_board_post_id`
  > Target post's [pol_econ_board_posts.id](#pol_econ_board_posts) (nullable when the target
  > is a comment).
- `pol_econ_board_comment_id`
  > Target comment's [pol_econ_board_comments.id](#pol_econ_board_comments) (nullable when the
  > target is a post).
- `note`: Optional short rationale or curator note for the recommendation.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp. Null means still active.
