### `pol_econ_board_bookmark_collections`

User-owned bookmark collections providing organization for bookmarks.
Each collection belongs to an account ([pol_econ_board_accounts](#pol_econ_board_accounts))
and can be referenced by many [pol_econ_board_bookmarks](#pol_econ_board_bookmarks). Names are
unique per owner to avoid duplicates. Text search over names is supported
via GIN. Soft delete is supported for reversible removal.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Owner account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `name`: Human-readable collection name. Unique per account for easier selection.
- `description`: Optional description to explain the collection’s purpose to the owner.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp, if the collection is removed but retained for
  > recovery.

### `pol_econ_board_bookmarks`

Per-user bookmarks for posts. Each bookmark belongs to an account ({@link
pol_econ_board_accounts}) and targets a post ({@link
pol_econ_board_posts}). Optionally associated with a {@link
pol_econ_board_bookmark_collections} folder. No post data is
denormalized; business logic computes display from joins.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Bookmark owner account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `pol_econ_board_post_id`: Target post's [pol_econ_board_posts.id](#pol_econ_board_posts)
- `pol_econ_board_bookmark_collection_id`
  > Optional collection's [pol_econ_board_bookmark_collections.id](#pol_econ_board_bookmark_collections) for
  > foldering.
- `note`: Optional personal note about the bookmark for the owner only.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp when the bookmark was added.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp (e.g., note or collection change).
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp when the bookmark is removed but retained for
  > recovery.

### `pol_econ_board_read_states`

Per-user reading telemetry for posts. Tracks first view, progress
percentage, and dwell seconds for a post. Belongs to an account ({@link
pol_econ_board_accounts}) and a post ([pol_econ_board_posts](#pol_econ_board_posts)).
Enforces one record per (user, post) to maintain a canonical source of
progress.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Reader account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `pol_econ_board_post_id`: Target post's [pol_econ_board_posts.id](#pol_econ_board_posts)
- `first_viewed_at`: Timestamp when the user first viewed the post.
- `progress_percent`: Latest known reading progress percentage (0–100).
- `dwell_seconds`: Cumulative engaged seconds measured by the application for the post.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if the state is purged logically.

### `pol_econ_board_follows`

Unified follows table allowing a user to follow either an author
(account), a tag, or a category. Exactly one of the target FKs should be
set per row. Prevents duplicates with composite uniques per follow type.
Follower is an account ([pol_econ_board_accounts](#pol_econ_board_accounts)); followed author
is [pol_econ_board_accounts](#pol_econ_board_accounts); taxonomy targets are {@link
pol_econ_board_tags} and [pol_econ_board_categories](#pol_econ_board_categories).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `follower_pol_econ_board_account_id`: Follower account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `followed_pol_econ_board_account_id`
  > Followed author account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts) (nullable
  > unless following an author).
- `pol_econ_board_tag_id`
  > Followed tag's [pol_econ_board_tags.id](#pol_econ_board_tags) (nullable unless following
  > a tag).
- `pol_econ_board_category_id`
  > Followed category's [pol_econ_board_categories.id](#pol_econ_board_categories) (nullable unless
  > following a category).
- `created_at`: Follow creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if the follow is removed logically.

### `pol_econ_board_feed_preferences`

Per-account feed preference profile controlling default sort and
personalization options. Exactly one row per account ({@link
pol_econ_board_accounts}); enforced via unique relation. Stores only raw
preference values; ranking logic derives behavior at runtime.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`
  > Account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts) for which these preferences
  > apply.
- `default_sort`: Default feed sort key (e.g., newest, most_reacted, most_agreed).
- `diversity_ratio`
  > Preferred diversity ratio in percent (0–100) used by feed composition
  > logic.
- `language`: Preferred content language code for feed filtering (e.g., en, ko).
- `prefer_expert_content`: Whether to prioritize expert-authored content in the personalized feed.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if preferences are archived or reset.

### `pol_econ_board_saved_items`

Per-user saved items for offline/late reading. Stores a point-in-time
text snapshot and metadata of a post ([pol_econ_board_posts](#pol_econ_board_posts)) as
saved by the account ([pol_econ_board_accounts](#pol_econ_board_accounts)). No derived
metrics are stored. One active snapshot per (user, post).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Owner account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `pol_econ_board_post_id`: Target post's [pol_econ_board_posts.id](#pol_econ_board_posts) at time of save.
- `snapshot_title`: Title captured at the time of save for the offline snapshot.
- `snapshot_body`
  > Text content captured at the time of save (media references excluded if
  > necessary).
- `snapshot_language`: Language code of the snapshot (e.g., en, ko).
- `saved_at`
  > Business timestamp when save action occurred (distinct from created_at if
  > needed).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when the saved item is removed logically.

### `pol_econ_board_muted_sources`

Per-user mutes that reduce or suppress visibility/notifications from
specific sources. A mute can target an author account, a post, a tag, or
a category. Follower is an account ([pol_econ_board_accounts](#pol_econ_board_accounts));
targets reference [pol_econ_board_accounts](#pol_econ_board_accounts), {@link
pol_econ_board_posts}, [pol_econ_board_tags](#pol_econ_board_tags), or {@link
pol_econ_board_categories}. Composite uniques per target type prevent
duplicates.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Muting account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `muted_pol_econ_board_account_id`
  > Muted author account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts) (nullable
  > unless muting an account).
- `pol_econ_board_post_id`
  > Muted post's [pol_econ_board_posts.id](#pol_econ_board_posts) (nullable unless muting a
  > post).
- `pol_econ_board_tag_id`: Muted tag's [pol_econ_board_tags.id](#pol_econ_board_tags) (nullable unless muting a tag).
- `pol_econ_board_category_id`
  > Muted category's [pol_econ_board_categories.id](#pol_econ_board_categories) (nullable unless
  > muting a category).
- `reason`: Optional free-text reason entered by the user for this mute.
- `expires_at`: Optional timestamp when the mute should automatically expire.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if the mute is lifted but retained for audit.

### `pol_econ_board_user_blocks`

User-to-user blocks that suppress visibility and interactions across the
platform at the account level. The blocker and the blocked are both
[pol_econ_board_accounts](#pol_econ_board_accounts). Composite unique ensures a single block
record per pair. Soft deletion enables reversible unblocking with audit
history.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `blocker_pol_econ_board_account_id`: Blocker account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `blocked_pol_econ_board_account_id`: Blocked account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `reason`: Optional free-text reason stored privately for the blocker.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if the block is lifted.

### `pol_econ_board_reports`

Individual user reports against content (post or comment). Stores
reporter, target reference, reason code, and optional notes at submission
time. Links to reporter tier snapshot for weighting without embedding
business logic. FKs to target content use SetNull to preserve evidence on
content deletion; taxonomy FKs (reason codes) use NoAction.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `reporter_account_id`: Reporter account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `post_id`
  > Reported post's [pol_econ_board_posts.id](#pol_econ_board_posts) (nullable when the target
  > is a comment).
- `comment_id`
  > Reported comment's [pol_econ_board_comments.id](#pol_econ_board_comments) (nullable when the
  > target is a post).
- `reason_code_id`: Reason taxonomy reference [pol_econ_board_reason_codes.id](#pol_econ_board_reason_codes).
- `reporter_tier_id`
  > Reporter tier snapshot at submission {@link
  > pol_econ_board_reporter_tiers.id}.
- `notes`: Optional free-text notes from the reporter to give context to reviewers.
- `weight`
  > Captured weight at submission time (e.g., credibility weighting). Not
  > calculated by DB; recorded as received.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp (report submitted at).
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for this report record.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp, if the report is retracted or purged under
  > policy.

### `pol_econ_board_moderation_cases`

lifecycle (status, SLA, assignment). Actions and sanctions are recorded
in [pol_econ_board_moderation_actions](#pol_econ_board_moderation_actions) and {@link
pol_econ_board_sanctions}. Assignment now references {@link
pol_econ_board_moderators} to enforce RBAC. The initial report link is
nullable and preserved on report deletion via SetNull.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.

- `pol_econ_board_moderator_id`: Assigned moderator's [pol_econ_board_moderators.id](#pol_econ_board_moderators).
- `status`: Current case status (e.g., triage, under_review, action_applied, closed).
- `priority`: Priority bucket used for queue ordering (lower is more urgent).
- `summary`: Optional case summary for human-readable context.
- `opened_at`: Case opening timestamp.
- `closed_at`: Case closure timestamp if resolved.
- `sla_due_at`: SLA due timestamp for first response or resolution per policy.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp for the case record.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp for the case record.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp if the case is obsoleted per policy.

### `pol_econ_board_notifications`

Core notification records representing business events addressed to a
single recipient account. Contains human-readable title/body, category
classification, optional actor (who triggered the event), and links to
the related resource by type/ID/URI. Individual channel delivery attempts
are tracked in [pol_econ_board_notification_deliveries](#pol_econ_board_notification_deliveries).
Preferences, quiet hours, and unsubscribes in related tables influence
whether deliveries are created, but the notification record itself
remains the canonical event. The optional actor link uses onDelete
SetNull to preserve notifications if the actor account is removed.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Recipient account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts).
- `actor_pol_econ_board_account_id`
  > Optional actor who initiated the event. Actor account's {@link
  > pol_econ_board_accounts.id}.
- `category`
  > Business category tag for the notification (e.g., account/security,
  > engagement, moderation, editorial, digest). Used for policy, filtering,
  > and compliance labels.
- `title`
  > Short human-readable title shown to the recipient in the notification
  > center and email subject lines.
- `body`
  > Optional human-readable summary or message body. For email, this may map
  > to preview text; for in-app, it supports concise copy.
- `priority`
  > Relative importance (e.g., low, normal, high). Used to sequence delivery
  > and presentation policies. Stored as raw string for policy flexibility.
- `coalescing_key`
  > Optional deduplication key used to roll up similar events (e.g., multiple
  > replies in a 10-minute window). When set, it enables composite uniqueness
  > per recipient.
- `resource_type`
  > Business type of the related resource (e.g., post, comment, case). Used
  > with resource_id to reconstruct deep links without hard foreign keys
  > across domains.
- `resource_id`
  > Opaque related resource identifier (not a foreign key) enabling
  > cross-domain linkage while preserving normalization boundaries.
- `resource_uri`
  > Optional direct URI to the related resource for deep linking. Prefer URI
  > when cross-service routing is needed.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp (KST business reference).
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for retention policy compliance.

### `pol_econ_board_notification_preferences`

Per-account preference records that govern whether specific notification
categories are enabled for specific channels (e.g., in-app, email). Each
row represents one category×channel scope for a single account.
Preferences are evaluated by the delivery engine before creating {@link
pol_econ_board_notification_deliveries}.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Owner account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts).
- `category`
  > Notification category (business taxonomy). Examples: account/security,
  > engagement, moderation, editorial, digest.
- `channel`: Delivery channel governed by this preference (e.g., in-app, email).
- `enabled`: Whether delivery is permitted for the category×channel scope.
- `snooze_until`
  > Optional snooze boundary; when set, delivery is suppressed until this
  > timestamp.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft deletion timestamp to support preference history without hard
  > deletes.

### `pol_econ_board_quiet_hours`

Per-account quiet hours windows that defer non-transactional
notifications. One record per day of week defines start/end minutes
within the day in the user's timezone. Evaluated together with {@link
pol_econ_board_notification_preferences} to suppress eligible deliveries.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Owner account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts).
- `day_of_week`: Day of week for the window (0=Sunday .. 6=Saturday).
- `start_minute`: Start minute-of-day (0–1439) in the user's timezone.
- `end_minute`
  > End minute-of-day (0–1439) in the user's timezone. If end < start, the
  > window crosses midnight.
- `timezone`: IANA timezone identifier used to interpret the window (e.g., Asia/Seoul).
- `enabled`: Whether the quiet hours rule is currently active.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp.

### `pol_econ_board_digest_schedules`

Per-account digest scheduling preferences. Supports daily and weekly
digests by storing digest_type (e.g., daily/weekly), optional day_of_week
for weekly, and minute-of-day for delivery. Delivery system uses this
with preferences to generate batched summaries. Enforces a single
schedule per digest type per account to prevent duplicates, while also
preventing multiple weekly entries for different weekdays.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Owner account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts).
- `digest_type`
  > Digest cadence (e.g., daily, weekly). Stored as a string to allow
  > policy-driven values without schema changes.
- `day_of_week`
  > Optional day of week for weekly digests (0=Sunday .. 6=Saturday). Null
  > for daily schedules.
- `hour_minute`
  > Minute-of-day (0–1439) when the digest should be sent in the user's
  > timezone.
- `timezone`
  > IANA timezone identifier (e.g., Asia/Seoul) determining the user's local
  > send time.
- `active`: Whether this schedule is active for generating digests.
- `next_run_at`
  > Optional next scheduled run timestamp used by schedulers to track backlog
  > and cadence.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp.

### `pol_econ_board_notification_deliveries`

Per-notification delivery attempts and outcomes by channel. Stores
delivery status, attempts, timing (queued/sent/read timestamps), and last
error for troubleshooting. Ensures a single row per notification×channel.
Reader experiences (e.g., read markers) for in-app are tracked here.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_notification_id`: Parent notification's [pol_econ_board_notifications.id](#pol_econ_board_notifications).
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`
  > Recipient account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts). Denormalized for
  > performance to filter by recipient quickly while preserving referential
  > integrity.
- `channel`: Delivery channel (e.g., in-app, email).
- `status`
  > Delivery state (e.g., queued, sent, failed, suppressed, read). Stored as
  > string to accommodate policy-driven additions.
- `attempts`: Number of delivery attempts performed for this channel.
- `last_error`
  > Last error message captured for troubleshooting when status=failed or
  > suppressed.
- `read`
  > Whether the recipient has read the notification for this channel (applies
  > primarily to in-app).
- `read_at`
  > Timestamp when the notification was marked read for this channel, if
  > applicable.
- `sent_at`
  > Timestamp when the delivery was successfully sent (e.g., handed to email
  > provider or presented in-app).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp.

### `pol_econ_board_unsubscribe_events`

Append-only history of unsubscribe (or global opt-out) actions by users
for a given category×channel, including reason and user-agent metadata.
Used for compliance and troubleshooting, and consulted to prevent future
deliveries unless preferences are re-enabled.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Owner account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts).
- `category`: Notification category to which the unsubscribe applies.
- `channel`: Channel for which the unsubscribe applies (e.g., email).
- `reason`
  > Optional human-entered reason or system code describing why the user
  > unsubscribed.
- `user_agent`
  > Optional user agent string captured at the time of unsubscribe for
  > diagnostics.
- `ip`: Optional IP address captured for compliance evidence (stored as text).
- `occurred_at`: When the unsubscribe action occurred.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp.

### `pol_econ_board_subscription_plans`

Subscription plan catalog defining commercial offerings for Premium
membership. Each plan captures pricing, billing interval, and activation
state. Referenced by [pol_econ_board_subscriptions](#pol_econ_board_subscriptions) to bind members
to a plan. Changes to price or interval create new plans rather than
mutating historical contracts.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `code`
  > Unique business code identifying the subscription plan (e.g.,
  > PREMIUM_YEARLY_KR). Stable identifier for contracts and coupons.
- `name`: Human-readable plan name for merchandising and admin search.
- `description`: Optional marketing or administrative description of the plan.
- `interval`
  > Billing interval unit (e.g., month, year). Business validation handled at
  > application layer.
- `interval_count`
  > Number of interval units per billing period (e.g., 1 for monthly, 12 for
  > yearly if using month).
- `price`: List price for the plan in the specified currency (per billing period).
- `currency`: ISO 4217 currency code for pricing (e.g., KRW, USD).
- `trial_days`: Optional free trial duration in days for new subscribers.
- `active`: Whether the plan is currently offered for sale.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when the plan is retired from availability.

### `pol_econ_board_subscriptions`

Member subscription contracts binding an account to a subscription plan.
Stores lifecycle timestamps, renewal settings, and snapshot unit price at
contract creation for audit and refunds. References {@link
pol_econ_board_accounts} and [pol_econ_board_subscription_plans](#pol_econ_board_subscription_plans).
Adds a composite index to speed plan×status cohort queries.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Subscriber account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `pol_econ_board_subscription_plan_id`: Chosen plan's [pol_econ_board_subscription_plans.id](#pol_econ_board_subscription_plans)
- `status`
  > Current subscription status (e.g., active, past_due, canceled, expired).
  > Application-level enum.
- `unit_price`
  > Snapshot price per billing period captured at subscription start for
  > audit and refunds.
- `currency`: Billing currency (ISO 4217) used for charges and refunds.
- `auto_renew`
  > Whether the subscription is set to auto-renew at the end of the current
  > period.
- `start_at`: Subscription start timestamp.
- `current_period_start`: Current billing period start timestamp.
- `current_period_end`: Current billing period end timestamp.
- `cancel_at`: Scheduled cancellation timestamp if set by the user or system.
- `ended_at`
  > Timestamp when the subscription ended (e.g., after cancellation takes
  > effect).
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp when the record is logically removed.

### `pol_econ_board_entitlements`

Entitlements granted by a subscription, such as ad-free or advanced
digests. Each record defines a specific capability key, its enablement

Properties as follows:

- `key`: Entitlement key identifier (e.g., ad_free, digest_advanced).
- `value`: Optional value or tier associated with the entitlement key.
- `enabled`: Whether the entitlement is enabled within the effective window.
- `effective_from`: Start of the entitlement's effective period.
- `effective_to`: End of the entitlement's effective period, if bounded.
- `created_at`: Creation timestamp.

- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for historical tracking.

Promotional coupon definitions used to discount subscriptions. Supports

### `pol_econ_board_consents`

Current consent state per account and communication category/channel with
optional scope granularity. Records provenance (source, evidence) and
locale/user-agent context. Immutable history is maintained in {@link
pol_econ_board_consent_logs}. The unique constraint includes scope to
enable separate consents per topic/campaign within the same
category×channel.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Subject account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `pol_econ_board_admin_id`
  > Recording admin's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins) (if staff recorded on
  > behalf)
- `category`
  > Consent category (e.g., marketing, engagement, digest).
  > Business-controlled taxonomy.
- `channel`: Communication channel (e.g., in_app, email). Business-controlled taxonomy.
- `scope`
  > Optional consent scope qualifier (e.g., specific topic, campaign, or
  > series) enabling granular consent distinctions under the same
  > category×channel.
- `granted`: Whether consent is granted (true) or declined/withdrawn (false).
- `granted_at`: When this consent state became effective.
- `revoked_at`: When consent was withdrawn (if applicable).
- `source`: Source of consent: signup, preferences_page, campaign, etc.
- `evidence_uri`: URI reference to evidence (e.g., message copy, signed form).
- `user_agent`: User agent string captured at consent time, if available.
- `locale`: Locale used when consent was captured (e.g., en-US, ko-KR).
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if the consent record is deprecated.

### `pol_econ_board_consent_logs`

Immutable consent change history (snapshot log). Each entry records an
action on a consent, including actor context and evidence. Supports
auditability and regulatory proof of consent lifecycle. Relates to {@link
pol_econ_board_consents} and [pol_econ_board_accounts](#pol_econ_board_accounts).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_consent_id`: Target consent's [pol_econ_board_consents.id](#pol_econ_board_consents)
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`
  > Subject account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts) for whom the consent
  > applies.
- `pol_econ_board_admin_id`
  > Acting admin's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins) when a staff member
  > performed the action.
- `action`
  > Action taken: grant, revoke, update. Textual classifier for business
  > interpretation.
- `reason`: Optional reason or note explaining the action context.
- `evidence_uri`: Evidence reference supporting this action (if any).
- `actor_role`: Role of the actor performing the action (member, admin, system).
- `occurred_at`: When the consent action occurred.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for redaction workflows (rare).

### `pol_econ_board_processing_activities`

Registry of personal data processing activities for compliance. Stores
human-readable codes, purposes, categories of data and recipients, lawful
bases, retention guidance, and approval flags. Used for audits, DPIA
references, and privacy notices.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `code`: Stable unique business code for the processing activity.
- `name`: Short name/title of the processing activity.
- `purpose`: Business purpose description for this processing activity.
- `data_categories`: Categories of personal data processed (free-text taxonomy).
- `recipient_categories`: Categories of data recipients/processors (free-text taxonomy).
- `lawful_basis`
  > Primary legal basis (e.g., contract, consent, legitimate_interest,
  > legal_obligation).
- `retention_period`
  > Retention policy summary (e.g., '90 days logs; 2 years moderation
  > records').
- `dpo_approved`: Whether DPO/compliance approved this activity.
- `notes`: Additional notes or DPIA references.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp, if deprecated.

Canonical Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) cases. Tracks requester
account, type (access, deletion, portability, rectification, restriction,
objection), verification status, lifecycle status, due dates, and a
unique tracking code. Event history captured in {@link
pol_econ_board_dsar_events}.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Requester account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `pol_econ_board_moderator_id`
  > Assigned moderator's [pol_econ_board_moderators.id](#pol_econ_board_moderators) handling the
  > case (optional).
- `pol_econ_board_admin_id`
  > Approving admin's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins) for
  > escalations/closures (optional).
- `type`
  > DSAR type: access, deletion, portability, rectification, restriction,
  > objection (business-controlled).
- `status`
  > Case status (e.g., received, verifying, in_progress, extended, fulfilled,
  > denied, closed).
- `verification_status`: Identity verification status (e.g., pending, success, failed).
- `submitted_at`: When the request was submitted.
- `due_at`: Primary due date based on regulatory SLA.
- `extended_until`: Extended due date if obtained under lawful conditions.
- `tracking_code`: Externally-shareable tracking code for the request.
- `channel`: Intake channel (e.g., in_app, email).
- `priority`: Business priority score for triage (higher = more urgent).
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp (if redacted).

  > Subject account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts) when request targets
  > a specific user (optional).
- `pol_econ_board_admin_id`: Handling admin's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins) (optional).
- `external_reference`: External reference or docket number from requesting authority.
- `jurisdiction`: Jurisdiction of the requesting authority (e.g., KR, US-CA).
- `request_type`: Type of lawful request (e.g., preservation, information, takedown).
- `scope`: Description of scope (data classes, time windows, subjects).
- `received_at`: When the request was received.
- `due_at`: When the response is due.
- `status`
  > Processing status (e.g., received, validating, in_progress, fulfilled,
  > denied, closed).
- `notified_user`: Whether affected user(s) were notified (unless prohibited).
- `disclosure_made`: Whether data was disclosed in response to the request.
- `requester_name`: Name of the requesting officer/official, if provided.
- `requester_agency`: Agency/department of the requester.
- `confidentiality`: Whether the request includes a confidentiality/gag order.
- `notes`: Internal notes and handling details.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp (redaction) when applicable.

### `pol_econ_board_legal_holds`

Legal hold records that freeze deletion/anonymization of specified scopes
(entity type + reference). Enforces at most one ACTIVE hold per
(scope_type, scope_reference_id). Placed by an admin with optional review
cadence.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_admin_id`: Placing admin's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins).
- `reference_code`: Business reference for the hold order.
- `scope_type`: Entity type under hold (e.g., account, post, case).
- `scope_reference_id`: UUID of the specific entity under hold.
- `reason`: Reason for the hold (business/legal rationale).
- `active`: Whether the hold is currently active.
- `started_at`: When the hold became effective.
- `ended_at`: When the hold ended (if applicable).
- `review_due_at`: Next review due date to validate continued need (optional).
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp (rare).

### `pol_econ_board_privacy_preferences`

Per-account granular privacy and communications preferences at
category×channel level. Includes quiet hours (DND), snooze, and locale.
Unique per (account, category, channel). Used by notification policy
enforcement and consent boundaries.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Owner account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `category`: Preference category (e.g., engagement, follows, moderation, digest).
- `channel`: Channel (in_app, email).
- `enabled`: Whether notifications are allowed for this category×channel.
- `dnd_start_at`: Start of Do-Not-Disturb window (optional).
- `dnd_end_at`: End of Do-Not-Disturb window (optional).
- `snooze_until`: Snooze until this time (optional).
- `locale`: Preferred locale for communications (e.g., en-US).
- `last_changed_at`: When the preference was last changed by the user or system.
- `reason`: Optional note on why the preference changed (e.g., unsubscribe link).
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp (if superseded).

### `pol_econ_board_data_deletion_requests`

Tracks account-initiated personal data deletion requests. Includes
cooling-off window, scheduled execution date, and completion timestamp.
May reference handling admin. Complements DSAR tracking where applicable.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Requesting account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts)
- `pol_econ_board_admin_id`: Handling admin's [pol_econ_board_admins.id](#pol_econ_board_admins) (optional).
- `tracking_code`: Business-visible tracking code for the deletion request.
- `requested_at`: When the deletion request was submitted.
- `scheduled_for`: When deletion is scheduled to execute (post cooling-off).
- `status`
  > Request status (e.g., pending, scheduled, executing, completed, deferred,
  > canceled).
- `reason`: Optional reason provided by the user or staff context.
- `cooling_off_until`: Cooling-off end timestamp where policy applies.
- `completed_at`: When deletion completed (if applicable).
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp (if superseded).

### `pol_econ_board_data_export_jobs`

Right-to-portability export jobs for accounts. Tracks job lifecycle,
artifact location, and expiry. Optionally links to a {@link
pol_econ_board_dsar_requests} case.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`: Requesting account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts).
- `pol_econ_board_dsar_request_id`: Related DSAR case [pol_econ_board_dsar_requests.id](#pol_econ_board_dsar_requests) (optional).
- `job_code`: Unique job code for external tracking and support references.
- `format`: Export format (e.g., json, csv, zip).
- `status`: Job status (e.g., queued, running, completed, failed, expired, canceled).
- `requester_note`: Optional note from requester clarifying scope.
- `requested_at`: When the job was requested.
- `started_at`: When processing started.
- `completed_at`: When processing completed.
- `expires_at`: When the artifact expires and becomes unavailable for download.
- `download_uri`: Temporary download link to the generated export artifact.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp (cleanup).

### `pol_econ_board_rate_limit_events`

Compliance-oriented log of rate limit hits and throttling actions.
Captures subject account (if any), action type, window/threshold,
retry-after, and context for audit and tuning. Supports investigation of
abuse and fairness complaints.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`
  > Subject account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts) (optional for
  > unauthenticated).
- `pol_econ_board_device_session_id`
  > Device session [pol_econ_board_device_sessions.id](#pol_econ_board_device_sessions) associated with
  > the event (optional).
- `actor_role`
  > Actor role at time of event (guest, member, expert, moderator, editor,
  > admin).
- `action`
  > Action category limited by rate policy (e.g., post_publish,
  > comment_create, react, report).
- `threshold`: Configured threshold descriptor that was exceeded (business label).
- `window_seconds`: Rate limit evaluation window in seconds.
- `retry_after_at`: Earliest time when the action can be retried (if applicable).
- `occurred_at`: When the rate limit event occurred.
- `ip`
  > IP address string as captured under minimization policy (may be
  > truncated/hashed).
- `device_id`: Device identifier string (policy-compliant).
- `notes`: Optional additional notes for audit/tuning.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp (cleanup).

### `pol_econ_board_abuse_signals`

Automated abuse/spam/bot detection signals with scores, severity,
detection windows, assignment, and resolution state. Used by moderators
([pol_econ_board_moderators](#pol_econ_board_moderators)) for triage. Additional indexes
optimize unresolved queue handling.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `pol_econ_board_account_id`
  > Subject account's [pol_econ_board_accounts.id](#pol_econ_board_accounts) if the signal
  > targets a specific user.
- `pol_econ_board_moderator_id`: Assigned moderator's [pol_econ_board_moderators.id](#pol_econ_board_moderators) (optional).
- `signal_type`: Signal type (e.g., spam_pattern, bot_velocity, brigading_correlation).
- `score`: Signal score reflecting severity (higher indicates stronger signal).
- `level`: Business-level severity label (e.g., low, medium, high, critical).
- `window_seconds`: Observation window in seconds used to compute the signal (if applicable).
- `first_detected_at`: First time this signal was observed.
- `detected_at`: Most recent detection time for this signal instance.
- `resolved`: Whether the signal has been resolved by operators or automated processes.
- `resolved_at`: When the signal was resolved, if applicable.
- `ip`: IP string associated with the signal, captured per minimization policy.
- `cluster_id`: Optional cluster/group identifier for correlated signals.
- `notes`: Optional reviewer notes and decisions.
- `created_at`: Record creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Record last update timestamp.
- `deleted_at`: Soft deletion timestamp for cleanup when permitted by policy.
